subject: C-suite post-call: impact roadmap, contracting asks and escalation owners
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@healthflow.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Sep 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps from today’s leadership call

Amelia — thanks again for taking time with Tom and the leadership team this morning. Short recap from our side and proposed path to move toward a pilot + contracting: 

Key business pains you confirmed
- Production latency spikes at peak hours (p90 currently ~850ms for inference paths) causing degraded clinical UX.
- Unpredictable token costs and opaque per-route spend — finance needs a bounded pilot cost.
- Auditability: procurement & security need per-token logs, retention controls, and SOC2 evidence.

Business outcomes that matter to you (call notes)
- Reduce inference p90 to <=200ms for critical read/write flows.
- Lower inference spend by ~25–35% on pilot workload vs current vendor.
- Pilot-grade audit trail and retention policy that satisfies internal compliance for 12 months.

Recommended path (we discussed these on the call):
1) 6-week pilot with a scoped subset of endpoints (clinical summarization + triage model).
2) Pilot SOW + limited committed capacity to lock predictable unit economics.
3) Parallel security evidence handoff (SOC2 report, data-retention settings, KMS integration plan).
4) Exec briefing with Tom + procurement to align on contracting triggers (SOW -> MSA -> PO).

Immediate asks / owners
- Amelia: confirm pilot scope and preferred pilot start window (you mentioned late Sept).
- Procurement: we requested a short procurement timeline spreadsheet; please share ideal PO lead time.
- Priyom (cc’d): I’ll push a draft SOW and a security questionnaire response by EOD tomorrow.

Attached: redwood-sow-draft-v1.pdf (pilot scope + pricing bands), healthflow-security-questions.xlsx (initial answers).

If that aligns I’ll schedule the 30-min exec briefing with Tom + procurement for next week.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@healthflow.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Sep 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today’s leadership call

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap. Summary from our side and a couple of clarifying asks: 

Confirmed
- Pain and outcomes: yes, the latency and cost concerns are top priorities. The compliance ask is non-negotiable for production.

Clarifying asks before exec briefing
- Procurement needs a one-page procurement timeline (ideal milestones: SOW sign -> MSA review -> PO issuance). I’ve attached our internal timeline for reference.
- Can you share an abbreviated SOC2 artifact or a statement of scope today? That will speed up procurement review.
- Ballpark on pilot pricing bands (we don’t need final numbers, just commit ranges for cost modeling).

Scheduling: Tom is available for a 30-min exec briefing next Thu (23 Sep) at 10:00am PT. Does that work for your team? If yes, please send an invite and include procurement.

Procurement note (from procurement@healthflow.com): we typically require 2–3 weeks for legal review of an MSA once the SOW is agreed; pilot contracts can be executed faster with an internal template.

Thanks — looping Tom and procurement.

Best,
Amelia Ross
Head of Product, HealthFlow
amelia.ross@healthflow.com | +1 (212) 555-0084

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Subject: Internal: plan to enable pilot + exec briefing (owners & deadlines)

Team — quick internal note based on Jonas/Amelia thread. High level plan and owners so we move fast: 

Goal: Lock a 6-week pilot with HealthFlow that demonstrates p90 latency <=200ms on scoped endpoints and provides procurement with auditable evidence.

Action items (owner — due):
- Draft SOW (Jonas) — include pilot metrics, success criteria, and optional scale pricing (Due: 2027-09-13 EOD).
- Security evidence package (Priyom) — SOC2 summary, retention controls, KMS integration plan, and a completed security spreadsheet (Due: 2027-09-14 noon).
- Pilot infra plan (Grace) — canary capacity, target qps, and rollout rollback criteria (Due: 2027-09-15).
- Pricing brief for exec (Kimberly) — 1-page cost ranges and ramp assumptions (Due: 2027-09-14 EOD).

Escalation owners (if blockers appear)
- Legal / Procurement gating (Kimberly) — if MSA redlines exceed acceptable thresholds, escalate to Sarah in Legal.
- Security gaps (Priyom) — escalate to CTO on remediation path; note: Tom Li indicated security signoff is a gating criteria.

Next external step: confirm 30-min exec briefing for Thu 23 Sep 10:00am PT. Jonas — send the invite and include procurement and Tom. Priyom/Grace, copy the security evidence + infra plan into the shared drive link (see related_links).

Keep this short and actionable; we want to protect margin on pilot but remove procurement friction.

Kimberly Park
VP, Sales — Enterprise
